page_title: CHE 2-0 EVE | Chelsea v Everton 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Thomas Bramall is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' A short pass finds Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The resulting set piece from Everton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.

89' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball goes out for a corner. Everton can continue in their attacking effort.
87' OFF THE POST! Good play from Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the right post!
84' The substitution is prepared. Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing James Garner.
84' Here is a change. Jack Grealish is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Tyler Dibling (Everton).

82' Reece James (Chelsea) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
81' Estêvão (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Joao Pedro.
76' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) has tested the patience of referee Thomas Bramall and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends the corner into the box, but Jordan Pickford intercepts it and averts the threat.

76' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.

74' Reece James (Chelsea) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Jordan Pickford to dive and make a save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.

73' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for an infringement. Chelsea win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
73' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
73' A cross into the box from Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) is cleared. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
72' A cross into the box picks out Jack Grealish (Everton), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.
72' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Carlos Alcaraz (Everton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play and Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
69' A rebound falls kindly for Andrey Santos (Chelsea), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Beto (Everton) for Thierno Barry.
67' Everton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

67' Jack Grealish (Everton) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the top left corner, but Robert Sanchez is prepared and leaps to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for Everton.
65' Here comes a substitution. Alejandro Garnacho is given a rest as he is replaced by Jamie Gittens (Chelsea).
63' Jack Grealish (Everton) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
62' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Bramall has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
61' The linesman signals that Thierno Barry (Everton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
59' Everton fail to score from a corner as Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) leaps to collect the ball.
59' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Everton get a corner.
58' Substitution. Cole Palmer makes way for Andrey Santos (Chelsea).
58' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle. Joao Pedro (Chelsea) commits a foul after dangerous play.
56' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar.
55' Jack Grealish (Everton) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
53' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
47' James Tarkowski (Everton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Bramall saw the whole situation.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Chelsea are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 0 Goal! Pedro Neto shows great vision to find Malo Gusto (Chelsea) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
45' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) tries his luck with a low long-range effort after receiving a precise pass, but Jordan Pickford has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
42' The Everton players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

38' What an opportunity! James Tarkowski (Everton) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
36' That's a well-taken pass by Pedro Neto (Chelsea). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
34' Thomas Bramall blows for a foul after Idrissa Gueye (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
34' Corner kick. James Garner (Everton) is ready to send the ball into the box.
33' Jack Grealish (Everton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Everton.
31' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

30' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Jordan Pickford. This effort really didn't trouble him.
27' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Bramall interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
24' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
21' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Malo Gusto plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Cole Palmer (Chelsea). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
20' Some great play by Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Robert Sanchez sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
19' Jack Grealish (Everton) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
19' James Garner (Everton) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. Good work from Everton as they win a corner.
18' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle after Pedro Neto (Chelsea) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Everton.
16' David Moyes is forced to make a change. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Everton).
13' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
12' Rough tackle by Jack Grealish (Everton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Referee Thomas Bramall sees the trip by Jack Grealish (Everton) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
6' James Garner (Everton) will take a corner kick.

6' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Everton will have a corner.
5' Reece James (Chelsea) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
4' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.

2' Jake O'Brien (Everton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The ball has crossed the sideline. Everton are taking a throw-in.
1' The match has just started.
Everton will kick-off.
Thomas Bramall will referee today's match.
